state.seed_assertion: The assessment shall contain a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the controller.

sentences.1: The assessment shall contain a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the controller.
sentences.2: a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the controller
sentences.3: The assessment must contain a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the controller.
sentences.4: a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the controller
sentences.5: Systematic monitoring of the position/location of employees as well as of the content and of the metadata of employee communications, provided that it is fair and with the exception of logging files for security reasons, when the processing is limited to the absolutely necessary data and is specifically documented is a type of processing subject to DPIA requirement.
sentences.6: Systematic monitoring - provided that it is fair - of the position/location of employees as well as of the content and of the metadata of employee communications with the exception of logging files for security reasons provided that the processing is limited to the absolutely necessary data and is specifically documented.
sentences.7: Any systematic monitoring, observation or control of individuals including that taking place in a public area or where the individual may not be aware of the processing or the identity of the data controller is a factor that may influence whether high risk is likely to result.
sentences.8: Any systematic monitoring, observation or control of individuals including that taking place in a public area or where the individual may not be aware of the processing or the identity of the data controller;
